name: Nämdö
description: Moderate 13.1 km multi-access island hike on Nämdö, with Solvik recommended as the clockwise start. The route mixes ferry quays, village lanes, active farm and pasture landscapes, forest paths, a quiet lake near Tjusvik, short sea-view detours and flexible exit points at several Waxholmsbolaget quays. Services are best at Solvik and Sand and are seasonal, while water/toilet details need winter caveats.
utilities: Best service cluster is Solvik: grocery, seasonal restaurant/bakery/pizza, ferry quay and harbor/fuel context.
Sand has the strongest official public utility note: toilet and water at the museum, not available in winter.
Solvik seasonal toilet/summer water is now corroborated by SAT and OSM, but remains seasonal and tied to the access/service spur.

Östanvik farm/farm shop is a strong seasonal POI and possible service detour; the Östanvik/Själudden tent site is confirmed but should be optional/detour-managed rather than default route-side camping.
Långvik sauna is a public Skärgårdsstiftelsen service but is a side-route/white-trail context, not a normal SAT facility marker. Långvik water remains unreliable for drinking-water rendering.
Hembygdsgårdens bodar near Sand are a lodging/service metadata candidate with booked simple huts, not a normal trail shelter or public utility.

No public charging point was confirmed through iteration 3. Solvik guest harbor/fuel belongs in service-cluster metadata only; do not infer electricity, public charging, showers, drinking water or pump-out from harbor presence.
A limited-availability AED at Nämdö Hembygdsförening/Sand was found in iteration 3 and is emergency metadata only, not a normal POI/facility.
Do not render ferry waiting shelters as overnight shelters.
waterSources: Sand museum / Gamla skolan: official SAT says water is available, not in winter; OSM water tap is at [59.1821550, 18.6886085].
Solvik: official step guide says summer water and OSM has public toilet/drinking-water tags at [59.1849827, 18.7006724]; treat as seasonal/service-spur utility, not year-round.
Östanvik: local/Visit Värmdö/OSM sources suggest fresh water; verify current availability and potability before relying on it as a primary refill.
Långvik pump: local/OSM context exists near [59.1999134, 18.7079436], but water testing/potability is uncertain; do not render as reliable drinking water yet.
Carry enough water outside high season and do not use private wells without permission.
notes: Route shape: multi-access Nämdö island section; SAT recommends starting at Solvik and walking clockwise, while the step-by-step guide describes the section from Nämdöböte.
Official SAT public distance/time/difficulty remain 13.1 km, 4:30 and Moderate despite 12.8 km export artifacts.
Use mainRouteBboxFromGpx for route map bounds; the broader bbox intentionally includes off-route metadata such as Idöborg and Ängsholmen.
Solvik is the recommended start and an access/service spur, but the strict GPX passes closer to church/Sand than the quay/service cluster.
Östanvik/Själudden tent site is confirmed by Naturkartan but should be optional/managed, not default wild-camping guidance.
Nämdöskärgården National Park information belongs in context/secondary POI only; national-park islands and services are separate boat/kayak destinations.
Iteration 3 replaced the earlier AED absence note with a guarded, limited-availability AED metadata record at Nämdö Hembygdsförening/Sand.
